title: An external world with simple probabilistic laws emerges

statements.text: With probability one the observer's chances converge to a simple computable measure, so it comes to appear to the observer as if there were an external world evolving under simple, computable, probabilistic laws. That world is one ontological model among many, not a fundamental fact.

sources.quote: it predicts that it appears to observers as if there was an external world that evolves according to simple, computable, probabilistic laws
